moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Reportedly being eyed by Paramount–WBD merger for investor group including CNN and CBS News
moments.why: Significant because it links the world’s richest man and X owner to control over major news networks.

moments.author: Unnamed user quoted by news
moments.quote: The Musk situation confirms our biggest fears: they want to control American news media
moments.why: Captures the public outrage and alarm over media consolidation tied to Musk.

moments.author: Converse (via Instagram/X)
moments.quote: We got this wrong — this should not have happened and we will do better.
moments.why: Viral apology for an ad accused of evoking KKK and lynching imagery that triggered widespread backlash.

moments.author: David Ellison (quoted)
moments.quote: Considering Elon Musk as part of investor group for our merger financing
moments.why: Breaks into men's conversation as a powerful media and business move shaping future content and capital.
